question.wording: Is this a single gift of $250 or more (separate donations are not combined) for which the taxpayer has no contemporaneous written acknowledgment from the charity?

options.label: No — under $250, or an acknowledgment is held

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this a single gift of $250 or more (separate donations are not combined) for which the taxpayer has no contemporaneous written acknowledgment from the charity?

citation.wording: In figuring whether a gift is $250 or more, don't combine separate donations.
